subject: Re: Financial Resilience & Controls questionnaire — control matrix and SLA clarifications
messages:
From: Julia Martin <julia.martin@acmebank.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>; lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: vendor-audits@acmebank.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Financial resilience questionnaire and controls mapping

Hi Rishi / Lauren,

Thanks for taking this RFI. Attached is Acme Bank's resilience and controls questionnaire (ref: RFI-Acme-1126). We're primarily concerned with:
- Control ownership and mapped evidence for business continuity and disaster recovery
- Encryption and key management for customer PII processed in hosted inference
- Audit log retention, tamper-proofing, and access reviews
- SLA definitions for availability and RTO/RPO expectations for dedicated/private deployments

Could you provide a control matrix that maps your controls to the sections in the questionnaire, cite concrete evidence (SOC 2, config artifacts, test dates), and indicate any gaps or exceptions? Procurement would like an initial response by EOD Thursday so we can include it in our supplier due diligence package.

Appreciate it,
Julia Martin
Vendor Risk & Resilience, Acme Bank
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Financial resilience questionnaire and controls mapping

Hi Julia,

Thanks for the questionnaire. We'll produce a control matrix with referenced artifacts and an SLA addendum draft. I'm looping in our Solutions Engineer (Lauren) and Security lead (Dev) to author the technical responses and attach evidence.

Plan:
- Dev will draft the controls mapping and link SOC 2 evidence + audit logs by Wed EOD.
- Lauren will populate the SLA section (availability, RTO/RPO, failover behavior) and include the BCP summary.
- I'll review and send a consolidated packet to you by Thu EOD.

One quick question: for SLA targets are you asking for dedicated deployment guarantees (private VPC) or hosted API baseline? Clarifying will help us scope the addendum.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 14:28:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Financial resilience questionnaire and controls mapping

Rishi / Lauren / Julia,

Attached is the initial control matrix (Redwood_Control_Matrix_ACME_v1.xlsx). Highlights:
- Encryption/KMS: Customer data at rest is encrypted using AES-256; for Private/Dedicated deployments we support customer-managed keys via KMS (HSM-backed) and provide an audit trail of key usage. Evidence referenced: SOC2 Type II 2026 (section CC6), KMS audit endpoint logs (sample IDs included).
- Audit logs & retention: Default retention for tenant-level request traces and admin audit logs is 90 days; extended retention available as a premium add-on (365/730 days) with WORM-like storage. Evidence: syslog export example, tamper-detection checksum logs.
- BCP & DR testing: Semi-annual failover drills for Dedicated customers; last full DR exercise 2026-07-18 (results attached in BCP-Executive-Summary.pdf). RTO targets: 99.5% restoration within 2 hours for dedicated pools; RPO: 15 minutes typical for active-standby setups.
- Monitoring & alerting: Multi-layer synthetic checks + customer-facing SLIs surfaced in Console (token-level latency, throughput), plus PagerDuty escalation for severity >= P1.

Gaps / Exceptions:
- For hosted shared API we cannot provide tenant-dedicated hardware guarantees — specific RTO/RPO numbers apply to Dedicated or Private deployments.
- For air-gapped on-premises installs, we provide an appliance bundle; certain telemetry-based features are limited.

I'll continue to pull sample log extracts and SOC 2 sections into the package.

Attachments referenced in matrix: SOC2-Type2_Redwood_Inference_2026.pdf, KMS-usage-sample.csv (redacted), BCP-Executive-Summary.pdf

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Security & Reliability Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Julia Martin <julia.martin@acmebank.com>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>; lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, procurement@acmebank.com
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:09:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Financial resilience questionnaire and controls mapping

Thanks Dev — this is helpful. A couple of clarifying points from our resilience team:
1) Please confirm if the 2-hour RTO for Dedicated pools is measured from incident detection or from the declared switchover window. We need the measurement anchor for our runbooks.
2) For audit logs, does Redwood support tamper-evident storage (append-only WORM) in the 365-day retention tier, and can you provide an example retention policy or config snippet?
3) For KMS, our auditors require proof of separation of duties for key rotation — can you provide a short description of IAM roles (who can rotate keys, who can access plaintext) and a redacted rotation event log?

Procurement would also like to see a draft SLA addendum with availability targets for Dedicated/Private that we can insert into our contract.

Appreciate quick confirmation on the three items above so we can close the RFI.

Julia
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Martin <julia.martin@acmebank.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>; dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:37:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Financial resilience questionnaire and controls mapping

Hi Julia — quick answers below and attached SLA draft.

1) RTO anchor: Our Dedicated RTO of 2 hours is measured from incident declaration (the time our on-call or monitoring automations create the incident ticket), not from the initial symptom. We'll include the incident declaration definition in the SLA addendum.

2) Tamper-evident logs: Yes — the 365-day retention tier uses WORM-backed object storage with immutable object versioning and SHA256 checksums logged to a write-once ledger. I attached an example retention policy snippet in SLA-Addendum_Draft.docx and a sample config JSON in the Drive link.

3) KMS separation of duties: Key management roles are split across two role classes: Key Admin (can create/rotate key metadata but cannot retrieve plaintext) and Key Operator (rotates keys using escrow procedures, operations team cannot retrieve customer plaintext without an explicit, auditable dual-approval workflow). We've attached a redacted rotation event log and included IAM role names in the control matrix.

Attachments in this message: SLA-Addendum_Draft.docx, Redwood_Control_Matrix_ACME_v1.xlsx, BCP-Executive-Summary.pdf

Next steps: Rishi — I can hand this to Legal/Procurement with the SOC 2 PDF and docs once you confirm we push to procurement.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
